cost: O((V+E) log(V+1) alpha(V)) time including component scans and final O(V log(V+1)) sort; O(V) auxiliary plus output. V<=1000000, E<=4000000. Resource caps reject before allocation/endpoint scans. Allocation exhaustion is not a recoverable API error.
description: Validated signed multigraph G maps to one minimum spanning forest F. Repeatedly choose each DSU component's least outgoing (weight,input index), union candidates in ascending root order, and stop at an unchanged partition; sort selected original indices. Minimize sum of edge weights separately in every connected component; retain isolates. The distinct total order resolves ties.

inverse: Fix observed F. The fiber includes every ordered multigraph whose deterministic rounds select those indices, whose selected weights sum to F.total_weight, and whose connectivity gives F.components. Unselected heavier edges, loops, and redistributed selected weights may be invisible. Even fixing n and selected indices does not reconstruct edge endpoints or all weights.
limitations: Finite oracle coverage is not proof.
Partial syntax leaves macros opaque; no performance claim.
state: Every selected edge joins distinct current components. Cut-minimal edges are safe; each successful round reduces every nonisolated remaining component population by at least a factor two. |F|=n-components. Sum uses i128 and at most 999999 signed i64 terms, so no arithmetic overflow.
